reader_identity_mirror: Every couple knows the tiny after-dinner negotiation where nobody wants to get up.
emotional_obstacle: A new-marriage fantasy of being served collides with the equal and opposite reality of living with someone who is just as quick.
aachu_proof: She understands his attempted shortcut instantly and stacks her own plate on top without a lecture.
zuv_active_role: He tries the handoff, gets outplayed, then carries both plates to the kitchen with mild comic defeat.
bridge: The scene turns from a lazy domestic trick into the comfort of two people who can be shameless with each other.
send_save_reason: Followers can send this to the partner who tries after-dinner shortcuts or silently wins them.
